supino-barra.objetivo: Chest strength and size with heavy loads. Requires good shoulder stability.
pontosChave: Shoulder blades squeezed together and down
Grip slightly wider than shoulders, not too wide
Bar comes down to the lower chest, elbows at ~45° from the torso

supino-halteres-neutro.objetivo: Trains the chest with less shoulder stress: the neutral grip keeps the elbows close to the torso.
pontosChave: Palms facing each other
Elbows at ~30–45° from the torso
Lower until you feel a stretch in the chest, without pain

supino-maquina.objetivo: Chest on a guided path; lets you add load with little risk.
pontosChave: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height
Back and shoulder blades against the pad
Do not lock the elbows at the top
Bench at 30°
Bar comes down to the upper chest
Shoulder blades squeezed together

supino-inclinado-halteres.objetivo: Upper chest with less shoulder stress.
pontosChave: Bench at 30°
Palms facing each other
Controlled descent

flexoes.objetivo: Chest and triceps with no equipment; the shoulder moves freely because the shoulder blades are not pinned.
pontosChave: Body in a straight line from head to feet
Elbows at ~45° from the torso
If it is too hard, put your hands on a bench

remada-cabo-sentado.objetivo: Back thickness and posture: horizontal pulling balances chest work.
pontosChave: Torso upright, no swinging
Pull the handle to your abdomen
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end

remada-halter-unilateral.objetivo: Back with bench support, which protects the lower back and helps fix side-to-side differences.
pontosChave: Hand and knee on the bench, neutral back
Pull the dumbbell towards your hip
Lower until you feel a good stretch

puxada-frente.objetivo: Back width (lats) with a vertical pull.
pontosChave: Grip shoulder-width or slightly wider
Pull the bar to the top of your chest
Do not pull behind the neck

puxada-neutra.objetivo: Lats with a neutral grip, usually more comfortable for shoulders and elbows.
pontosChave: Chest slightly up
Pull to chin/chest
Controlled return

elevacao-lateral.objetivo: Side delts (shoulder width) with a light load.
pontosChave: Light load, no swinging
Raise to shoulder height, not above
Arms slightly in front of the body

face-pull.objetivo: Rear delts and external rotators: helps balance the shoulder for people who do a lot of pressing.
pontosChave: Pulley at face height
Pull the rope towards your eyes, separating your hands
Elbows high, rotate the arms out at the end
Torso leaning forward, neutral back
Open the arms with elbows slightly bent
Light load
Elbows close to the torso
Turn the palm up as you lift
Lower slowly

curl-martelo.objetivo: Biceps and brachialis, with a neutral grip that is kinder to the wrist.
pontosChave: Palms facing each other
Elbows fixed
No torso swinging
Elbows tucked to the torso
Spread the rope ends at the bottom
Only the forearm moves

triceps-polia.objetivo: Triceps with a heavier load than the rope.
pontosChave: Elbows fixed at your sides
Extend fully
Controlled return

triceps-halteres-deitado.objetivo: Triceps with dumbbells, lying on a bench.
pontosChave: Arms vertical
Bend only the elbows, dumbbells beside the head
Moderate load

leg-press.objetivo: Leg strength and size with the spine supported.
pontosChave: Lower back always against the seat
Knees in line with the feet
Do not lock the knees at the top

agachamento-goblet.objetivo: Squat with the weight in front: makes it easier to keep the torso upright and learn the pattern.
pontosChave: Dumbbell against your chest
Sit down between your legs, torso upright
Knees follow the direction of the feet

agachamento-bulgaro.objetivo: One leg at a time: balance, glutes and quads with little load on the spine.
pontosChave: Back foot on a bench
Lower straight down
Start with body weight only
Knee lined up with the machine's axis
Lift until straight, lower slowly
No momentum

peso-morto-romeno.objetivo: Hamstrings and glutes through the hip hinge.
pontosChave: Neutral back from start to finish
Push the hips back, knees slightly bent
Bar always close to the legs
Neutral back
Hips back
Dumbbells close to the legs
Hips pressed into the bench
Bend the knees all the way
Slow descent
Knee lined up with the axis
Lock the thighs in firmly
Controlled descent

hip-thrust.objetivo: Glutes with heavy loads and little demand on the lower back.
pontosChave: Shoulder blades on the bench
Chin down, lift until the hips are in line
1 s pause at the top

ponte-gluteos.objetivo: Glutes on the floor, no equipment.
pontosChave: Feet close to the glutes
Lift the hips by squeezing the glutes
Do not arch the lower back
Lower until the heel is well stretched
1 s pause at the top
No bouncing

prancha.objetivo: Core stability: learning to keep a neutral spine under effort.
pontosChave: Forearms under the shoulders
Squeeze glutes and abs
Stop when the lower back starts to sag

dead-bug.objetivo: Core control with the lower back protected on the floor.
pontosChave: Lower back pressed into the floor
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg
Breathe out as you extend

crucifixo-halteres.objetivo: Isolates the chest with a controlled stretch, without help from the triceps.
pontosChave: Elbows slightly bent and fixed
Lower only until you feel a stretch, with no shoulder pain
Bring the dumbbells together over the chest in an arc

crucifixo-maquina.objetivo: Isolates the chest on a guided path with little stability demand.
pontosChave: Seat set so the hands are at chest height
Shoulder blades against the pad
Close the arms without banging the wrists

crucifixo-cabo.objetivo: Isolates the chest with constant tension through the movement.
pontosChave: One foot forward for stability
Elbows slightly bent
Bring the hands together in front of the chest, controlling the return

supino-inclinado-maquina.objetivo: Upper chest on a guided path; a good alternative to the incline barbell press.
pontosChave: Handles at upper-chest height
Shoulder blades together
Press without locking the elbows

paralelas.objetivo: Lower chest and triceps with body weight.
pontosChave: Torso leaning slightly forward
Lower until the shoulders reach elbow height, no further
No shoulder pain; if it hurts, stop

flexoes-inclinadas.objetivo: An easier push-up, useful to get started or to train at home.
pontosChave: Hands on a stable bench or table
Body in a straight line from head to heels
Chest close to the support

remada-curvada-barra.objetivo: Back thickness with heavy loads; requires a stable lower back.
pontosChave: Torso at ~45°, neutral back
Pull the bar to your navel
Do not swing the torso

remada-maquina.objetivo: Back without loading the lower back: the chest is supported.
pontosChave: Chest against the pad
Pull the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades
Return slowly, arms straight

elevacoes.objetivo: Vertical pull with body weight; a great measure of relative strength.
pontosChave: Grip shoulder-width or slightly wider
Start with arms straight and shoulder blades down
Chin over the bar without swinging

remada-invertida.nome: Inverted row (body under a low bar)
remada-invertida.objetivo: Back training with body weight, on a low bar (a reachable pull-up bar or a bar in a rack).
pontosChave: Body in a straight line
Pull your chest to the bar
The more horizontal the body, the harder it is

pullover-cabo.objetivo: Isolates the lats without help from the biceps.
pontosChave: Arms almost straight
Bring the bar to your thighs in an arc
Torso slightly leaning and still

hiperextensao.objetivo: Posterior chain: glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
pontosChave: Hips supported just below the hip bone
Lower with a neutral back
Rise until the body is in line, without overextending
Arms straight at your sides
Lift the shoulders towards the ears
1 s pause at the top, without rolling the shoulders

desenvolvimento-halteres.objetivo: Shoulder strength and size with an overhead movement.
pontosChave: Backrest almost vertical
Dumbbells at ear level, elbows slightly forward
Press without arching the lower back

desenvolvimento-maquina.objetivo: Overhead pressing on a guided path.
pontosChave: Handles at shoulder height
Back against the pad
Press without locking the elbows

press-landmine.objetivo: Pressing up and forward, on a path that is usually kinder to the shoulder.
pontosChave: Bar end in a corner or holder
Press up and forward
Torso braced, no twisting
Low pulley, cable crossing in front of the body
Raise to shoulder height
Elbow slightly bent

elevacao-frontal.objetivo: Front delts; usually already well worked by pressing.
pontosChave: Raise to shoulder height
No torso swinging
Lower slowly
Elbows close to the torso
Lift without swinging
Use an EZ bar if your wrist bothers you
Elbows fixed
Lift to full contraction
Lower over 2 s

curl-concentrado.objetivo: Isolated biceps, with no way to swing.
pontosChave: Seated, elbow against the inner thigh
Lift slowly
Extend fully at the bottom
Bench at ~60°
Arms hanging behind the torso
Do not move the elbows forward

triceps-frances.objetivo: Long head of the triceps in a lengthened position.
pontosChave: Dumbbell held with both hands
Elbows pointing forward
Lower behind the head only as far as is comfortable

triceps-corda-acima.objetivo: Triceps in a lengthened position, with constant tension.
pontosChave: Back to the pulley, rope behind the head
Elbows fixed
Extend to in front of the head

fundos-banco.objetivo: Triceps with body weight, no equipment.
pontosChave: Hands on the bench at hip width
Lower to ~90° at the elbows
Shoulders away from the ears
Hands at shoulder width
Elbows close to the torso
Bar to the lower chest

agachamento-barra.objetivo: The basic leg exercise; requires technique and mobility.
pontosChave: Bar on the traps, feet shoulder-width apart
Lower with a braced torso as far as you can keep a neutral back
Knees in line with the feet

agachamento-hack.objetivo: Quads with heavy loads and the back supported.
pontosChave: Back against the pad
Feet in the middle of the platform
Lower under control, without lifting the heels

afundos.objetivo: Legs one side at a time, with balance.
pontosChave: Long stride
Back knee almost touches the floor
Torso upright

step-up.objetivo: Legs one side at a time, with little load on the lower back.
pontosChave: Bench at knee height
Push with the top leg, without bouncing off the bottom one
Lower slowly
Feet shoulder-width apart
Lower as if sitting on a chair
Weight on the heels and mid-foot

peso-morto-barra.objetivo: Strength for the whole posterior chain; requires careful technique.
pontosChave: Bar close to the shins
Neutral back, chest up
Push the floor away and extend hips and knees together

peso-morto-unilateral.objetivo: Hamstrings and glutes with less load and more balance.
pontosChave: Standing leg slightly bent
Hips go back, free leg rises behind
Neutral back

abducao-maquina.objetivo: Glute medius, important for hip and knee stability.
pontosChave: Back against the pad
Open the legs under control
1 s pause when open
Ankle strap on the low pulley
Take the leg back without arching the lower back
Squeeze the glute at the end

ponte-gluteos-unilateral.objetivo: Glutes with no equipment, one leg at a time.
pontosChave: Lying on your back, one foot on the floor and the other leg straight
Lift the hips until in line with the torso
1 s pause at the top

gemeos-sentado.objetivo: Calves with the knee bent (more soleus).
pontosChave: Pad over the knees
Lower until well stretched
Lift and pause 1 s

gemeos-leg-press.objetivo: Calves with the leg straight, with a stable load and no weight on the shoulders.
pontosChave: Only the balls of the feet on the platform
Knees almost straight, not locked
Full range and a pause at the top

prancha-lateral.objetivo: Side core muscles and hip stability.
pontosChave: Forearm under the shoulder
Body in a straight line
Do not let the hips drop

pallof.objetivo: Anti-rotation core: resisting the torso from twisting.
pontosChave: Side-on to the pulley, cable at chest height
Press the hands straight out
Keep the torso from twisting
Lower back pressed into the floor
Lift the legs to 90°
Lower slowly without arching
Rope next to the head
Curl the torso, bringing the elbows to the thighs
Do not pull with the arms

bird-dog.objetivo: Lower-back stability and coordination; safe for people with lower-back pain.
pontosChave: On all fours
Extend the opposite arm and leg
Torso still, without rotating the hips

farmer-walk.objetivo: Grip, traps and core while walking with a load.
pontosChave: Heavy dumbbells at your sides
Torso upright, shoulders back
Short, controlled steps

flexoes-declinadas.objetivo: Upper chest and shoulders without equipment: with your feet on a chair or sofa, your hands carry more of your body weight.
pontosChave: Feet on a stable chair, sofa or step
Body in a straight line, hips not sagging
Elbows at ~45° from the torso

flexoes-diamante.objetivo: Triceps without equipment: with the hands together, the elbows bend more and the triceps do more of the work.
pontosChave: Thumbs and index fingers form a diamond under the chest
Elbows close to the torso
If too hard, do them with your hands on a bench

flexoes-pike.objetivo: Shoulders without equipment: with the hips high, the push becomes vertical, similar to an overhead press.
pontosChave: Body in an inverted V, hips high
Lower your head between and slightly in front of your hands
To make it harder, put your feet on a step

remada-mochila.objetivo: Back training at home without dumbbells: a backpack with books or water bottles is the weight. When it gets easy, add more to the backpack.
pontosChave: Hand and knee resting on a chair, neutral back
Pull the backpack towards your hip, elbow close to the body
Backpack well closed, straps firm

elevacao-y.objetivo: Rear shoulders and mid-back without equipment, to balance all the pushing in home workouts.
pontosChave: Lying face down, arms in a Y above your head, thumbs up
Lift the arms off the floor by squeezing the shoulder blades
Pause 1 s at the top, without arching the lower back

curl-deslizante.objetivo: Hamstrings without a machine: the feet slide on a towel or socks on a smooth floor.
pontosChave: Lying on your back, heels on a towel, hips raised
Pull your heels towards your glutes without letting your hips drop
Return slowly; single-leg comes later

cadeira-isometrica.objetivo: Quadriceps without equipment or impact: sit on an imaginary chair with your back against the wall.
pontosChave: Back against the wall, knees at ~90°
Knees above the ankles
Breathe normally; stop if your knee hurts

puxada-elastico.objetivo: Vertical pull at home: a band anchored high on a door (with a proper door anchor) works like a pulley.
pontosChave: Band firmly anchored high on the door, door closed and opening away from you
Pull the elbows down and back, chest up
To make it harder, use a stronger band or step further from the door

face-pull-elastico.objetivo: Rear shoulders and rotator cuff with a band, to balance pushing and protect the shoulder.
pontosChave: Band anchored at face height
Pull towards your face, hands apart and elbows high
Pause 1 s at the back, without shrugging

curl-elastico.objetivo: Biceps at home without dumbbells: the band gets harder at the top of the movement.
pontosChave: Stand on the band with both feet
Elbows close to the torso
Lower slowly, without swinging

abducao-caneleira.objetivo: Gluteus medius, which stabilises the hip and knee. The ankle weight makes it harder.
pontosChave: Lying on your side, body in a straight line
Lift the top leg slightly backwards, foot parallel to the floor
Do not roll the hip back; at the top of the range, use a heavier ankle weight

coice-gluteo.objetivo: Isolated gluteus maximus at home. The ankle weight makes it harder.
pontosChave: On all fours, hands under shoulders
Push the heel towards the ceiling with the knee at 90°
Do not arch the lower back; stop when the thigh is in line with the torso

flexoes-parede.objetivo: The first rung of pushing: learn the push-up position with little weight on the hands.
pontosChave: Hands on the wall at chest height, slightly wider than the shoulders
Body in a straight line, heels raised
The further your feet are from the wall, the harder it gets

flexoes-joelhos.objetivo: A push-up with half the weight: builds chest and triceps before the full push-up.
pontosChave: Knees on the floor, body straight from knees to head
Hands under the shoulders, elbows at ~45° from the torso
Chest almost touching the floor on every rep

flexoes-arqueiro.objetivo: The road to the one-arm push-up: one arm does almost all the work and the other only helps, stretched to the side.
pontosChave: Hands wide apart, twice shoulder width
Lower towards one side, with the other arm straight
Count the reps on each side

flexoes-pseudo-planche.objetivo: A push-up with the shoulders far in front of the hands: prepares shoulders and wrists for the planche.
pontosChave: Hands beside the waist, fingers turned out or back
Lean forward until the shoulders pass the hands
Arms almost straight at the top, keeping the lean

flexoes-um-braco.objetivo: A pushing strength skill: the whole body has to resist rotating.
pontosChave: Feet wide apart for balance
Hand under the shoulder, elbow close to the torso
Hips and shoulders parallel to the floor; start with the hand on a bench

flexoes-pike-elevadas.objetivo: More weight on the shoulders than the pike push-up: the step before handstand push-ups.
pontosChave: Feet on a chair or sofa, hips over the shoulders
Head lowers in front of the hands, forming a triangle
Elbows go back, not out to the sides

flexoes-pino-negativas.objetivo: Only the lowering of the handstand push-up, slowly: builds strength for the way up.
pontosChave: In a handstand facing or with your back to the wall
Lower in 3 to 5 s until the head touches a cushion
Come down and kick up again; do not press up until you control the lowering

flexoes-pino-parede.objetivo: The full vertical push with body weight, using the wall for balance.
pontosChave: Hands a hand-span from the wall, shoulder-width apart
Head and hands form a triangle at the bottom
Body tight, without arching the lower back

mergulhos-negativos.objetivo: Only the lowering of the dip, slowly: the step between bench and parallel bars.
pontosChave: Start at the top, arms straight
Lower in 3 to 5 s until the shoulders reach elbow height
Get back up with help from your feet

suspensao-ativa.objetivo: The first rung of pulling: hold your body hanging, with active shoulders.
pontosChave: Hang with straight arms
Pull the shoulders down, away from the ears, without bending the elbows
Legs together and still

elevacoes-negativas.objetivo: Only the lowering of the pull-up, slowly: the most direct way to your first pull-up.
pontosChave: Jump or step up on a chair until the chin is over the bar
Lower in 3 to 5 s to straight arms
Stop if the lowering gets fast

elevacoes-peito.objetivo: A higher pull-up, chest touching the bar: more strength at the top of the movement, the base of the muscle-up.
pontosChave: Pull the elbows down and back
Chest to the bar, body leaning slightly back
Lower to straight arms

elevacoes-arqueiro.objetivo: The road to the one-arm pull-up: one arm pulls and the other helps, straight along the bar.
pontosChave: Very wide grip
Pull up towards one arm, with the other straight
Count the reps on each side

muscle-up.objetivo: A skill that combines an explosive pull-up with a dip over the bar.
pontosChave: Grip slightly narrower than for pull-ups, thumbs over the bar
Pull hard to the waist and get the chest over the bar
Finish with a dip to straight arms

elevacoes-um-braco.objetivo: A pulling skill: the whole body goes up on one arm.
pontosChave: Start with the other hand on the wrist or on a towel, helping
Active shoulder, not hanging on the joint
Count the reps on each side

remada-invertida-alta.objetivo: A row with the body almost upright, on a bar at chest height: the easiest rung of horizontal pulling.
pontosChave: Bar at chest height, feet in front of it
Body straight, leaning back
Chest to the bar, shoulder blades together

remada-invertida-pes-elevados.objetivo: An inverted row with the body horizontal: more weight for the back.
pontosChave: Feet on a chair or box, body parallel to the floor
Hips in line with the shoulders
Chest to the bar, lower slowly

remada-arqueiro.objetivo: A row in which one arm does almost all the work: prepares the one-arm pull-up.
pontosChave: Wide grip, body under the bar
Pull towards one side, with the other arm straight
Count the reps on each side

afundo-recuado.objetivo: One leg at a time, without load: stepping back is kinder to the knee than the forward lunge.
pontosChave: Take a big step back
Back knee lowers almost to the floor; front knee stays over the foot
Push through the front heel to come back

pistol-assistido.objetivo: A single-leg squat holding a door frame or post: learns the range and the balance.
pontosChave: Hold a door frame or post in front of you
The other leg straight in front, off the floor
Lower as far as the heel stays down; use the arms only as needed

pistol-caixa.objetivo: A pistol without hand support down to a box or chair: the last step before the full pistol.
pontosChave: Back to a chair or box
Lower on one leg until you touch lightly, without dropping
Lower the box height over time

pistol.objetivo: A full squat on one leg: strength, ankle mobility and balance.
pontosChave: Arms in front for balance
Lower all the way with the heel down
Stand up without letting the knee cave in

agachamento-camarao.objetivo: A single-leg squat with the other leg bent behind: lots of quadriceps work with the knee well forward.
pontosChave: Hold the back foot with the hand on the same side
Lower until the back knee touches the floor
Start with a cushion under the knee

hip-thrust-unilateral.nome: Single-leg hip thrust (shoulders on a sofa)
hip-thrust-unilateral.objetivo: A single-leg bridge with more range: with the shoulders on a sofa or bench, the hips can drop lower.
pontosChave: Upper back on the sofa, one foot on the floor
Raise the hips until the torso is in line with the thigh
Squeeze the glute for 1 s at the top

nordico-negativo.objetivo: Only the lowering of the nordic curl: the equipment-free exercise that strengthens the hamstrings the most.
pontosChave: Kneel on a cushion, heels anchored under a sofa or held by someone
Body straight from knees to head; lower as slowly as you can
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up with them

nordico.objetivo: Lower and come back up using only the hamstrings: maximum eccentric and concentric strength.
pontosChave: Heels firmly anchored
Lower slowly with the body straight
Come up without pushing with the hands; help only at the bottom if needed

hollow-fletido.objetivo: The base position of gymnastics, easier: lower back pressed to the floor with the torso and legs in the air.
pontosChave: Lying on your back, knees bent over the hips
Shoulders off the floor and arms along the body
Lower back always pressed to the floor

hollow.objetivo: The body shape of almost every skill: abs braced and lower back pressed to the floor.
pontosChave: Legs straight and together, a few hand-spans off the floor
Arms straight behind the head
If the lower back lifts, raise or bend the legs

l-sit-encolhido.objetivo: Hold your body on your hands with the knees to the chest: abs, shoulders and triceps at once.
pontosChave: Hands on the floor, on two books or on parallel bars
Arms straight and shoulders down
Knees to the chest, feet off the floor

l-sit.objetivo: Legs straight in front at hip height, with the body supported on the hands.
pontosChave: Start tucked and straighten one leg at a time
Legs together and straight, toes pointed
Shoulders down, neck long

v-sit.objetivo: A compression skill: the legs rise above the hips, in a V, with the body on the hands.
pontosChave: Start from the L-sit
Push the floor away and lean the shoulders back
Raise the legs without bending the knees

elevacao-joelhos-barra.objetivo: A hanging ab exercise: bring the knees to the chest without swinging.
pontosChave: Hanging, shoulders active
Raise the knees and curl the pelvis
Lower slowly, without swinging

elevacao-pernas-barra.objetivo: Straight legs raised to horizontal or higher, while hanging: a longer lever than the knees.
pontosChave: Legs together and straight
Raise them at least to horizontal
Control the lowering to avoid swinging

pes-a-barra.objetivo: Raise straight legs until the feet touch the bar: compression and straight-arm back strength.
pontosChave: Push the bar down with straight arms
Legs together until the feet touch the bar
Lower slowly

dragon-flag-negativo.objetivo: Only the lowering of the dragon flag: the straight body lowers, supported only on the shoulders.
pontosChave: Lying on a bench, holding on behind your head
Raise the straight body to vertical, resting on the shoulders
Lower in 3 to 5 s without bending at the hips

dragon-flag.objetivo: A core skill: lower and raise the straight body, supported only on the shoulders.
pontosChave: Body straight from shoulders to feet
Lower almost to horizontal and come back up
Stop when the hips start to bend

pino-parede-costas.objetivo: The first handstand: kick up with your back to the wall and hold upside down.
pontosChave: Hands a hand-span from the wall, fingers spread
Kick up with one leg; heels against the wall
Arms straight, push the floor; come down by turning to the side

pino-parede-frente.objetivo: A handstand facing the wall: a more aligned body, as in the freestanding handstand.
pontosChave: Walk your feet up the wall, belly facing it
Hands two hand-spans from the wall, body straight
Look at your hands; walk back down

pino-livre.objetivo: A balance skill: hold the handstand without a wall, correcting with the fingers.
pontosChave: Practise in a clear space with a soft floor
Correct balance with pressure from the fingers and palm
Learn to bail out by turning before trying to hold

front-lever-encolhido.objetivo: The first rung of the front lever: body horizontal under the bar, knees to the chest.
pontosChave: Arms straight, pull the bar down
Back parallel to the floor, knees against the chest
Shoulders back, not shrugged

front-lever-encolhido-avancado.objetivo: A front lever with a flat back and the knees further from the chest: a longer lever.
pontosChave: Back flat, not rounded
Hips open, thighs at 90° to the torso
Arms straight the whole time

front-lever-uma-perna.objetivo: One leg straight and the other tucked: the step before the full front lever.
pontosChave: Body horizontal, one leg straight
The other leg bent, knee to the chest
Switch legs every set

front-lever.objetivo: A skill: the whole body straight and horizontal, hanging with straight arms.
pontosChave: Body straight from shoulders to feet
Glutes and legs tight, legs together
Arms straight, pull the bar towards the hips

skin-the-cat.objetivo: Rotate the body under the bar and back: shoulder mobility for the back lever.
pontosChave: Hanging, bring the knees to the chest and pass the legs between the arms
Lower only as far as the shoulder stretches without pain
Come back slowly the same way

back-lever-encolhido.objetivo: Body horizontal facing down, behind the bar, with the knees to the chest.
pontosChave: Enter through skin the cat
Back parallel to the floor, knees to the chest
Arms straight, elbows not bending

back-lever.objetivo: A skill: the whole body straight, horizontal and facing down, behind the bar.
pontosChave: Body straight, glutes tight
Lower slowly from an inverted hang
Arms straight; stop if the elbow hurts

planche-lean.objetivo: In push-up position, lean the body forward: the first rung of the planche.
pontosChave: Fingers turned out or back
Arms straight, shoulders moving in front of the hands
Upper back slightly rounded, shoulder blades apart

planche-encolhida.objetivo: Body in the air, on the hands only, with the knees tucked: the first planche without the feet on the floor.
pontosChave: Arms straight, lean until the feet leave the floor
Knees to the chest, back rounded
Start with the hands on low parallettes or books

planche-encolhida-avancada.objetivo: A planche with a flat back and the knees further from the chest.
pontosChave: Back flat, parallel to the floor
Hips open, knees bent under the body
Arms always straight

planche-afastada.objetivo: A planche with the legs straight and apart: a shorter lever than the full planche.
pontosChave: Legs straight and wide apart
Body horizontal, at shoulder height
Glutes tight, arms straight

planche.objetivo: A skill: the whole body straight and horizontal, supported only on the hands.
pontosChave: Legs together and straight
Body straight at shoulder height
Years of training: progress through the rungs, without rushing
